question: Approve the resume-notice design (a 'Resumed without N project variables' row at the end of the first turn after a resume, not repeated for the same failure) and AC-1 into implementation? FO recommends approving, which also accepts that the line shows when that first turn ends, not when the chat is opened. Say if you object to any part.

artifacts.summary: FO recommendation: approve. Gap confirmed on isolated Paseo 0.14.0: a resume fires agent.session_open with reason resume, an unreadable variable goes blank, and no line shows. Candidate: 320/320 tests, 6 of 6 mutations killed; row at turn end stays visible, a row at turn start is folded by the default Chat display, and an append in the opening hook fails. Viewing a released agent also resumes it, so the repeat rule matters. Not observed: unreadable case on an unpatched one-hour release, real provider, desktop app, failed turn. design_surfaces exit 0.
